'''524''' was a group of two [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]] that served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were part of the [[Task force/Legends|task force]], led by the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Invincible (Strike Fear)|''Invincible'']], during [[Operation Strike Fear]]. While mustering in the [[Dellalt system/Legends|Dellalt system]] they were identified as carrying power units by a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] reconnaissance mission flown by [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] in a lone [[R-22 Spearhead starfighter|A-wing]] starfighter.<ref name="X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide">''[[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref>
